body:
📦 **meadow-recruit1185 `2666cf7c`** — feat: add port tavern recruitment and ten-role officer cards

Import 22 named portraits with original profiles and author/commit provenance.
Add a new refined pixel-art tavern background. Recruitment and assignment use
world-owned unique characters, deterministic weekly candidates, conserved
recruitment payments, daily wages/arrears and per-ship ten-role slots.

Town and globe entries open the same responsive host modal. Store officer
ownership and slots in ledger.json through real savePack/saveUnpack. Hosted
work-efficiency snapshots feed the existing core efficiency system.

Verified real Tortuga recruitment: Selena cost 270, player funds 500 -> 230;
assigned surgeon and reopened configuration through the 3D town entry, showing
medical efficiency +9%. CPU checks cover duplicate hire, atomic incompatible
assignments, unique transfers, money conservation, payroll once per day,
arrears, save directory roundtrip, baseline fallback and real core isolation.
390px UI check: ten slots, no horizontal overflow. Core build: 188/42 passes.

Limits: the world currently has one persistent player ship; multiple world-owned
ships can store slots, but battle-menu multi-ship composition is not a persistent
world fleet. Full departure validation remains on TASK-1185. Portraits retain
original white card backgrounds; transparent full-stage cutouts are future art.

Refs TASK-1185
Refs TASK-1172

👥 參與者：@meadow
